summary: OddOneGaming reviews the teaser trailer for Child of Chaos, an upcoming hero featuring a unique Element Switch Mechanic. This mechanic allows Child of Chaos to align with any of the six elements, offering unprecedented team composition flexibility. In-game gameplay footage shows melee attack animations, Attack Penalty debuffs, and a cinematic ultimate. The creator advises players to start saving 300 Heliolite Dice in anticipation of a dedicated banner.
